_comment: Self-hosted profile (OW_PROFILE=selfhosted). Differs from the default app profile in three ways: LiveSync is auto-ENABLED rather than installed-but-disabled; `provision.configUrl` points at a same-origin endpoint supplying this deployment's LiveSync settings; and `provision.vault.autoOpen` makes a cold visit CREATE and open a local OPFS vault instead of falling through to Obsidian's native 'Where is your vault located?' onboarding. All three are required for the zero-click promise -- without the vault the seeder never runs at all, because it lives inside the vault-open branch of boot.js. The endpoint is expected to sit behind the deployment's own identity gate and be served no-store; if it 404s, seed-livesync-config.js falls back to the manual flow and this profile behaves like the app profile with LiveSync pre-enabled.
